description.text: Course Object One-semester's time, two or three-semester progress Intensive Chinese program is an Carefully orchestrated course provided by the International College of Chinese Studies(ICCS), Shanghai Normal University. Based on the rule of second language learning, with scientific curriculum, large amount of information, highly-intensive training, various extracurrilar activities, pure Chinese environment, the course is to help students to make breakrough progress in Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing in short term. HSK 3 will be reached in one semester and HSK 6 will be reached in two semesters. Target Group Students who want to improve their Chinese proficiency in short run

duration.text: The Intensive Chinese Program at Henan Normal University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per semester ￥ 17000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of highest education

requirements.text: Students must be in good health High School Graduate.
